0.original: Judging by the hunter's jovial expression, the hunt is still on.

48.original: The great hunter returns. You did well taking on that Rathalos.

49.original: Though I must ask: was the battle grueling? Did the mountains sing with the sound of claws clashing with steel?

52.original: It was admittedly more trouble than I expected.

53.original: Ah, but of course. Perhaps battle with a high-ranking Rathalos would have put a bit of sweat on your brow.

54.original: Truly? I shudder to think what would have happened had you encountered a high-ranking Rathalos, then.

55.original: Piqued your curiosity, have I? Well, I can only tell you what I've heard.

56.original: They say there is a stronger brood of Rathalos that would make short work of your average hunter.

57.original: Mayhap that kitten friend of yours knows something of it. He was, after all, the one who originally posted a bill for the beast.

58.original: No need to worry over it now, though. I'd say you've earned a rest after your recent exertions in the Azim Steppe. When you're up for another hunt I'll be here, ready and waiting.

59.original: The mighty hunter returns, and with <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> feline companion!

60.original: Feline!? How rude! I am a <hex:021A020203>Felyne<hex:021A020103> you dullard!

61.original: I...fail to see the difference...<hex:02100103>Ahem. But that is neither here nor there. I asked <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203> to bring you here that we might learn the truth of these high-ranking Rathalos I recently caught wind of.

62.original: High Rank Rathalos? They're an older, much more powerful brood of wyvern...

63.original: Without sufficient protection, even the simplest of swipes is all it would take to rend a hunter in two.

64.original: If I didn't know better, I'd say you were talking about an elite mark. Yes, a challenge no self-respecting hunter can ignore!

65.original: It's settled, then. Are you ready, my friend?

67.original: Your enthusiasm is appreciated, but now isn't the time to be kitten around. To be purrrfectly plain, I'd rather not see another hunter charbroiled today.

68.original: You have unlocked the Great Hunt (Extreme). Test your mettle against High Rank Rathalos and reap rich rewards!

69.original: Please note you may only enter the Great Hunt (Extreme) with four players.
